summary: Frontend-only verification of the June 2026 shop unification + add-to-cart-from-search fix. All requested behaviours verified on the web preview: search now uses the ProductGridCard (no -33%/4.4*/48k reviews/heart/strikethrough), add-to-cart from search works end-to-end (POST /cart/add succeeds, stepper appears, +/- reach the server, cart badge increments), stepper hydration on category screen works (Test Widget already in cart renders stepper qty=1 instead of Add), admin layout block Add on the CATEGORY screen fires POST /cart/add and increments the cart, the 'Added • <name>' toast flashes for <2s, optimistic rollback restores the Add button + cart count when /cart/add is blocked, category screen has no cat-prev/cat-next arrows and no swipe toast, bottom tabs Shop→Services→Dashboard→Chat→Profile all navigate, and /orders still shows the multi-vendor '1 checkout · 2 sellers' header + 'Ask this seller' + status filters. The Test Widget stepper on the category screen hydrates correctly when the item is already in the cart. Duplicate /shop-layout fetch from [name].tsx confirmed removed. The ONE case not verifiable on web is the admin layout block Add on the SHOP HOME (the block was returned by API but never rendered because the enclosing <FadeSlideIn> keeps opacity at 0 on react-native-web — this is the same pre-existing Reanimated web bug the request flagged as 'do NOT report as regression'; identical code path works on the category screen, so this should work on native).

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing (not a regression from this iteration): on react-native-web the <FadeSlideIn> wrapper starts at opacity 0 and never animates to 1, hiding all content it wraps. This is why the admin product_grid layout block on shop-home is invisible in the web preview. Reference: /app/frontend/src/anim/fade-slide-in.tsx (useSharedValue(0) + useAnimatedStyle) combined with /app/frontend/src/shop-home.tsx:813 `<FadeSlideIn triggerKey=...><ShopLayoutRenderer scope="home" ... /></FadeSlideIn>`. Same class of bug already noted for the buyer Dashboard blank-below-earnings-card. The layout block DOES render on the category screen because [name].tsx does not wrap ShopLayoutRenderer in FadeSlideIn. This blocks web-based E2E verification of home-scope layout Add buttons but should be fine on native — do not flag as a bug of this iteration.

Console spam on every render of a product_grid layout block: `Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>.` (fires 20+ times when the TEST Category Grid block mounts). Almost certainly a stray whitespace/newline between a `<View>` open tag and its first child in shop-layout-renderer.tsx or one of the block sub-components. Non-blocking on web but will crash on native RN. Reference: /app/frontend/src/shop-layout-renderer.tsx (product_grid block, likely inside gridImgWrap or gridFooter).

action_items: OPTIONAL: fix the RN-Web FadeSlideIn opacity-stuck-at-0 issue in /app/frontend/src/anim/fade-slide-in.tsx so the home-scope admin layout blocks render on the web preview too (add a Platform.OS === 'web' fallback that sets initial opacity to 1, or use react-native-reanimated's `worklet` on web).

Fix the stray-whitespace `Unexpected text node` warnings in /app/frontend/src/shop-layout-renderer.tsx (esp. inside the product_grid block — the warning fires many times when that block renders). Currently a JS warning on web but a hard crash on native RN.

Test agent seeded 2 admin layout blocks (product_grid on scope=home + product_grid on scope=category General) via POST /api/admin/shop-layout and DELETED them at the end of the run. The 'General' shop-category (id 1b0f6b73-...) was also DELETED via POST /api/admin/shop-categories/{id} to restore the DB to zero categories (the state it was in before). If you want to re-seed for further manual verification, run POST /api/shop-categories with { name: 'General', ... }.
Buyer cart was emptied at the end of the run (0 items).
critical_code_review_comments: shop-home.tsx line 813: the <FadeSlideIn triggerKey=...> wrapping the entire <ShopLayoutRenderer scope='home' ...> is why every home admin layout block is invisible on RN-Web. Consider unwrapping or gating by Platform.OS.

shop-layout-renderer.tsx product_grid block still renders a wishlist heart pill overlay on the tile (line ~577). Not part of this iteration's user complaint (they only asked to unify SEARCH cards), but flagging for consistency because ProductGridCard has no heart. Leave as-is unless product wants the layout block to also match.

rca_of_issue: No open bug this iteration. The reported user bug (add-to-cart from search silently failing) has been verified fixed: the search results grid now renders the shared ProductGridCard whose Add button routes through useShopCart → POST /cart/add (server returns {ok:true}, cart badge updates, /cart GET confirms the row is present with correct qty). The dead-code paths that used to POST plain /cart or never call onAddToCart are gone (verified via grep + successful click test).
